verdict.rationale: GitCafe is a Git forge with a documented pull request workflow. Developers can open pull requests (including one per commit via `cafe stack submit`), compare diffs, leave feedback and reviews alongside the code, and land or merge PRs. Rulesets can require reviews, code-owner approval and passing CI checks before merge. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration (all evidence is vendor docs), and detailed docs on the basic single-PR create, comment-thread and merge flow outside of stacks.
